text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Test-driven development, or TDD, means writing tests before writing the actual code, which helps developers plan better and avoid mistakes. Regular testing gives teams confidence that their software is reliable and safe to release. Without good tests, small problems can grow into serious bugs. In short, testing is not just extra work—it is a key step that leads to better, stronger software.
